ordinary participle ‘praising.’

Arcanānas. — In one passage of the Rigveda^1 the gods Mitra-
Varuṇa are besought to protect Arcanānas. He is also in-
voked with Śyāvāśva and several other ancestors enumerated
in the Atharvaveda.^2 He appears as father of Śyāvāśva in the
Pañcaviṃśa Brāhmaṇa.^3 The later tradition makes him play a
part in the legend of his son's wedding, which Sieg^4 endeavours
